upright.zh: 起步、天真、纵身一跃
upright.en: beginnings, innocence, a leap taken on faith

reversed.zh: 鲁莽、准备不足、逃避承担
reversed.en: recklessness, stepping off before looking, avoidance

upright.zh: 资源齐备、意志集中、开始行动
upright.en: resources at hand, focused will, making it happen

reversed.zh: 手段散乱、说服过头、能力被浪费
reversed.en: scattered effort, manipulation, talent left idle

upright.zh: 直觉、尚未说出口的知晓、静观
upright.en: intuition, knowledge not yet spoken, watching

reversed.zh: 忽视内在声音、信息被隐瞒、过度封闭
reversed.en: ignoring the inner voice, withheld information, shutting down

upright.zh: 滋养、丰盛、让事情自然生长
upright.en: nurture, abundance, letting things grow

reversed.zh: 过度付出、依赖、创造力停滞
reversed.en: over-giving, dependence, creativity stalled

upright.zh: 秩序、边界、承担责任
upright.en: structure, boundaries, taking responsibility

reversed.zh: 控制过度、僵硬、权威带来的压迫
reversed.en: over-control, rigidity, authority that presses down

upright.zh: 传承、规则、向有经验者学习
upright.en: tradition, shared rules, learning from someone experienced

reversed.zh: 因循守旧、被规范束缚、需要自己的解法
reversed.en: convention for its own sake, constraint, needing your own answer

upright.zh: 关系、共鸣、需要做出选择
upright.en: connection, resonance, a choice that must be made

reversed.zh: 价值不一致、犹疑、关系失衡
reversed.en: misaligned values, hesitation, imbalance

upright.zh: 前进、掌控方向、以意志推动
upright.en: forward motion, holding the reins, will in charge

reversed.zh: 方向不明、内耗、用力过猛
reversed.en: no clear direction, friction within, forcing it

upright.zh: 柔韧的勇气、与情绪共处、耐心
upright.en: soft courage, sitting with feeling, patience

reversed.zh: 自我怀疑、情绪压过判断、勉强撑住
reversed.en: self-doubt, feeling running the show, white-knuckling it

upright.zh: 独处、向内寻找、慢下来看清
upright.en: solitude, looking inward, slowing down to see

reversed.zh: 孤立、拖延面对、拒绝支持
reversed.en: isolation, postponing the reckoning, refusing help

upright.zh: 转折、时机到来、顺势而变
upright.en: a turn, timing arriving, moving with the shift

reversed.zh: 抗拒变化、错过窗口、循环重演
reversed.en: resisting change, a window missed, the same loop again

upright.zh: 权衡、如实面对、后果分明
upright.en: weighing, seeing it as it is, consequences that land

reversed.zh: 偏颇、回避责任、判断被情绪染色
reversed.en: bias, dodging accountability, judgment tinted by feeling

upright.zh: 暂停、换个角度、主动等待
upright.en: pause, a reversed angle, waiting on purpose

reversed.zh: 停滞、无谓牺牲、拖着不决定
reversed.en: stagnation, pointless sacrifice, deciding not to decide

upright.zh: 结束、让旧的离开、彻底的转化
upright.en: an ending, letting the old go, real transformation

reversed.zh: 拒绝告别、卡在过渡期、旧模式续命
reversed.en: refusing the goodbye, stuck mid-transition, old patterns on life support

upright.zh: 调和、找到比例、慢火细炖
upright.en: blending, finding the proportion, a slow simmer

reversed.zh: 失衡、极端、耐心用尽
reversed.en: imbalance, extremes, patience run out

upright.zh: 束缚、欲望、看清自己被什么绑住
upright.en: bonds, appetite, seeing what has hold of you

reversed.zh: 松动、开始挣脱、承认代价
reversed.en: the grip loosening, breaking away, naming the cost

upright.zh: 突变、结构崩解、真相冲破表面
upright.en: sudden change, a structure giving way, truth breaking through

reversed.zh: 延迟的崩塌、勉强修补、恐惧变动
reversed.en: a collapse deferred, patching what should fall, fear of upheaval

upright.zh: 希望、疗愈、重新相信
upright.en: hope, healing, believing again

reversed.zh: 信心动摇、疲惫、看不见出口
reversed.en: faith wavering, depletion, no exit in sight

upright.zh: 不确定、潜意识、雾中前行
upright.en: uncertainty, the underneath, walking through fog

reversed.zh: 迷雾散去、误会澄清、恐惧被看穿
reversed.en: the fog lifting, a misreading cleared, fear seen for what it is

upright.zh: 清晰、生命力、事情摊在光下
upright.en: clarity, vitality, everything in plain light

reversed.zh: 光被遮住、乐观勉强、延迟的好消息
reversed.en: light obscured, forced optimism, good news delayed

upright.zh: 召唤、清算过去、做出回应
upright.en: a call, reckoning with the past, answering it

reversed.zh: 自我苛责、听不见召唤、悬而未决
reversed.en: self-reproach, the call unheard, left unresolved

upright.zh: 完成、整合、一个阶段圆满
upright.en: completion, integration, a chapter whole

reversed.zh: 差最后一步、收尾未竟、迟迟不肯结束
reversed.en: one step short, loose ends, refusing to close it

upright.zh: 行动与热情上，一个全新的开端正在出现
upright.en: In action and drive, a fresh opening is presenting itself

reversed.zh: 行动与热情上，开端被耽搁，机会还没被接住
reversed.en: In action and drive, the opening is delayed, the offer not yet taken

upright.zh: 行动与热情上，两股力量需要被放到一起权衡
upright.en: In action and drive, two forces are asking to be weighed together

reversed.zh: 行动与热情上，取舍被拖延，平衡还没找到
reversed.en: In action and drive, the choice is postponed, the balance not yet found

upright.zh: 行动与热情上，最初的成果已经可以看见
upright.en: In action and drive, the first results are visible

reversed.zh: 行动与热情上，进展慢于预期，配合出了偏差
reversed.en: In action and drive, progress lags, the collaboration is off

upright.zh: 行动与热情上，稳定下来，把已有的守住
upright.en: In action and drive, settling, holding what is already there

reversed.zh: 行动与热情上，安稳变成停滞，抓得太紧
reversed.en: In action and drive, stability turned stagnant, holding on too tight

upright.zh: 行动与热情上，出现冲突与失衡，需要重新对齐
upright.en: In action and drive, conflict and imbalance, asking to be realigned

reversed.zh: 行动与热情上，争执渐息，损耗开始被修复
reversed.en: In action and drive, the dispute settling, the damage starting to mend

upright.zh: 行动与热情上，交流与给予让局面重新流动
upright.en: In action and drive, exchange and giving get things moving again

reversed.zh: 行动与热情上，付出与回报不对等，流动被卡住
reversed.en: In action and drive, give and take out of proportion, the flow blocked

upright.zh: 行动与热情上，需要评估，并决定坚持什么
upright.en: In action and drive, a moment to assess and decide what to hold

reversed.zh: 行动与热情上，摇摆不定，标准还没立起来
reversed.en: In action and drive, wavering, no standard set yet

upright.zh: 行动与热情上，投入加速，事情开始快速推进
upright.en: In action and drive, commitment accelerating, things moving fast

reversed.zh: 行动与热情上，节奏失控，方向没有跟上速度
reversed.en: In action and drive, pace out of hand, direction not keeping up with speed

upright.zh: 行动与热情上，接近完成，只差最后的坚持
upright.en: In action and drive, near completion, one last stretch

reversed.zh: 行动与热情上，独自硬撑，防备心过重
reversed.en: In action and drive, carrying it alone, guard held too high

upright.zh: 行动与热情上，一个循环走到尽头，圆满或负荷已满
upright.en: In action and drive, a cycle at its end, complete or fully loaded

reversed.zh: 行动与热情上，负担该被卸下，结局需要重新定义
reversed.en: In action and drive, a load ready to be set down, an ending to redefine

upright.zh: 行动与热情上，带着好奇去试，允许自己是新手
upright.en: In action and drive, trying with curiosity, allowed to be a beginner

reversed.zh: 行动与热情上，三心二意，学习停在表面
reversed.en: In action and drive, half-hearted, learning left on the surface

upright.zh: 行动与热情上，主动出击，为目标全力奔赴
upright.en: In action and drive, taking the initiative, going all in

reversed.zh: 行动与热情上，冲动或迟疑，行动没有落到点上
reversed.en: In action and drive, impulsive or stalled, action not landing

upright.zh: 行动与热情上，以涵容与体察去处理，照顾到人
upright.en: In action and drive, holding it with care, attending to people

reversed.zh: 行动与热情上，情绪耗竭，界线被模糊
reversed.en: In action and drive, emotionally spent, boundaries blurred

upright.en: In action and drive, mature command, owning the outcome

reversed.zh: 行动与热情上，强势或缺席，掌控变成压制
reversed.en: In action and drive, domineering or absent, command turned into pressure

zh.title: 理解目前状态
zh.description: 看见眼前处境、尚未察觉的影响，以及可以采取的方向。
zh.instruction: 请以「理解目前状态」为主轴解读：先辨认现况，再指出未被看见的因素，最后给出可行方向。
zh.example: 我现在的工作状态到底怎么样？有什么是我还没看清的？

guidance.response: 回到来访者的问题，给出综合回应，说明牌面对这个具体处境意味着什么。
guidance.actions: 两到三条现实中可以做的事，每条独占一行，以「- 」开头，具体、可执行、不空泛。
guidance.reflection: 一个留给对方自己想的问题，一句话。

situation.title: 此刻的处境
situation.prompt: 第一张，照见你此刻所处的位置。

hidden.title: 隐藏的影响
hidden.prompt: 第二张，揭示尚未被你看清的影响。

guidance.title: 接下来的指引
guidance.prompt: 最后一张，指向你接下来可以采取的行动。

zh.title: 做一个决定
zh.description: 整理选择的拉力、取舍，以及值得依循的原则。
zh.instruction: 请以决策为主轴，不替来访者决定，也不要预言结果；比较各方拉力，点出取舍，最后提出一个可用来判断的原则。回到问题时，把接受与不接受两边的得失并列写出，不要说哪一边“分量较重”“更重”或“更该选”，也不要用语气暗示倾向。
zh.example: 我该接受新的工作机会，还是留在现在的公司？

guidance.response: 回到来访者的问题：把他要在哪些选项之间取舍说清楚——每个选项各自会得到什么、要放下什么。问题里没写明选项时，就从问题推出最可能的两边。不要替他选，也不要暗示哪一边“对”，也不要说牌面让哪一边或“改变”“留下”显得更重、更大、更占上风，或用“倾向”“偏向”这类比较词。改为说明每张牌各自提醒他去衡量什么，两边的得失用同样的分量写。
guidance.actions: 两到三条帮助他做决定的现实步骤，每条独占一行，以「- 」开头，例如：把某个选项最坏和最好的结果各写下来、向某个具体的人确认一个事实、给自己设一个做出决定的期限。要具体、可执行，而不是直接告诉他该选什么。
guidance.reflection: 一个帮他分辨自己真正想要什么的问题，一句话，不带倾向。
guidance.followUp: 继续帮他权衡，而不是替他决定：如果追问在问“该选哪个”，就回到各个选项的取舍和可用来判断的原则，不给答案。

quickFollowUps: 这几张牌里，哪一张最提醒我该衡量什么？
两边各自最坏的情况是什么？
在做决定之前，我可以先确认哪一件事？

situation.title: 真正要决定的是什么
situation.prompt: 第一张，照出这个决定真正牵动的事。

hidden.title: 选择背后的拉力
hidden.prompt: 第二张，揭示让你靠近或避开某个选项的力量。

guidance.title: 值得依循的原则
guidance.prompt: 最后一张，提出一个可以帮你衡量选项的原则。

zh.title: 下一步反思
zh.description: 找到值得关注的地方、第一个小步骤，以及需要留意的信号。
zh.instruction: 请聚焦在可采取的下一步：辨认优先事项，提出一个小而具体的行动，并指出后续值得观察的信号。
zh.example: 我想开始做一个自己的副业，第一步该从哪里着手？

guidance.response: 回到来访者的问题，只谈眼前，不谈整个未来：指出现在最该优先的一件事、为什么是它，以及可以先放一放的部分。
guidance.actions: 恰好两条，每条独占一行，以「- 」开头：第一条是一个小到今天或本周就能开始的行动，写清楚做什么、怎么做；第二条是一个要留意的信号，说明出现什么迹象代表方向对了，或需要调整。
guidance.reflection: 一个帮他确认“这一步够不够小、自己愿不愿意走”的问题，一句话。
guidance.followUp: 保持在“下一步”的尺度：把回答落到一个更小、更具体的行动或一个可观察的信号上，不要展开成长期规划。

quickFollowUps: 这一步还能再小一点吗？
我要留意的信号具体会是什么样子？
如果今天只有十分钟，我该做什么？

situation.title: 现在最值得关注
situation.prompt: 第一张，指出此刻最值得你留意的地方。

hidden.title: 可以开始的小步骤
hidden.prompt: 第二张，照出一个可以开始的小步骤。

guidance.title: 接下来留意什么
guidance.prompt: 最后一张，提醒你接下来可以观察的信号。

zh.title: 每周回顾
zh.description: 回看这周发生的事、带走一个领悟，并为下周留出空间。
zh.instruction: 请协助来访者回顾一周，而非预言未来：整理这周的主题、辨认留下的领悟，再提出一个下周可以带着走的意图。
zh.example: 回顾这一周：我经历了什么、学到了什么，又想带着什么走进下周？

guidance.response: 回到来访者的问题，以“这一周”为范围：这周发生了什么、哪里消耗了他、哪里给了他力量，以及他带走的是什么。如果问题与这周无关，就把它当作这周背景的一部分，不要转去预测未来。
guidance.actions: 两到三条下周可以带着走的具体做法，每条独占一行，以「- 」开头：一件想继续做的事、一件想放下或调整的事，以及一个放进下周日程的小意图。不要写成宏大的目标。
guidance.reflection: 一个让他回看这一周的问题，一句话，指向已经发生的事，而不是预测。
guidance.followUp: 保持在“这一周”的范围：帮他回看已经发生的事和留下的领悟，不预测未来，也不替下周做大计划。

quickFollowUps: 这一周里，哪一件事最值得我记住？
哪一张牌最像这一周的我？

situation.title: 这周的主题
situation.prompt: 第一张，回望这周最鲜明的主题。

hidden.title: 带走的领悟
hidden.prompt: 第二张，照出这周留下的领悟。

guidance.title: 下周的意图
guidance.prompt: 最后一张，为下周指出一个可以带着走的意图。

en.title: Understand where things stand
en.description: See the situation, what is out of view, and a direction you can take.
en.instruction: Read this as a way to understand the current situation: name what is happening, what is not yet in view, and a practical direction.
en.example: Where do things really stand with my work right now, and what am I not seeing?

guidance.response: Back to their question: what this spread means for this specific situation.
guidance.actions: Two or three things they can actually do, each on its own line starting with "- ", concrete and doable.
guidance.reflection: One question for them to sit with, a single sentence.

situation.title: Where you stand
situation.prompt: The first card shows where you are standing now.

hidden.title: The hidden influence
hidden.prompt: The second card reveals what has not yet come into view.

guidance.title: What comes next
guidance.prompt: The last card points to a move you can make from here.

en.title: Make a decision
en.description: Clarify the pull, the trade-off, and a principle to decide by.
en.instruction: Read this as decision support. Do not decide for the visitor or predict an outcome; compare the forces, name the trade-off, and offer a principle they can use. When you come back to their question, set the cost and gain of each side next to each other; never say one side weighs more or should win, and never lean by tone.
en.example: Should I take the new job offer, or stay where I am?

guidance.response: Back to their question: lay out what they are choosing between — what each option would give them and what it would cost. If the question names no options, infer the two most likely sides. Do not choose for them or hint that one side is "right", and never say the cards make either side, or "changing" or "staying", weigh more, count for more or come out ahead, and avoid words like "lean" or "tilt". Instead say what each card asks them to weigh, and give both sides the same weight on the page.
guidance.actions: Two or three practical steps that help them decide, each on its own line starting with "- " — for example writing down the worst and best realistic outcome of an option, checking one fact with a specific person, or setting a date by which to decide. Concrete and doable; never a verdict on what to pick.
guidance.reflection: One question that helps them tell what they actually want, a single sentence, leaning neither way.
guidance.followUp: Keep helping them weigh, not deciding for them: if the follow-up asks "which one should I pick", return to the trade-offs and the principle to decide by, and do not give a verdict.

quickFollowUps: Which card most points at what I should weigh?
What is the worst case on each side?
What can I check before I decide?

situation.title: What is really being decided
situation.prompt: The first card shows what this decision is really about.

hidden.title: The pull beneath the choice
hidden.prompt: The second card reveals what is pulling you toward or away from an option.

guidance.title: A principle to decide by
guidance.prompt: The last card offers a principle for weighing your options.

en.title: Reflect on the next step
en.description: Find your focus, one small first move, and a signal to watch.
en.instruction: Focus on a next step: identify the priority, suggest one small concrete action, and name a signal worth watching.
en.example: I want to start a side project of my own. Where should the first step be?

guidance.response: Back to their question, about what is in front of them and not the whole future: name the one thing to put first, why it is that one, and what can wait.
guidance.actions: Exactly two, each on its own line starting with "- ": first, one action small enough to begin today or this week, with what to do and how; second, one signal to watch for — what would show the direction is right, or needs adjusting.
guidance.reflection: One question that checks whether this step is small enough and whether they are willing to take it, a single sentence.
guidance.followUp: Stay at the scale of the next step: land the answer on one smaller, more concrete move or one observable signal, and do not expand it into a long-term plan.

quickFollowUps: Can this step be made even smaller?
What would the signal I am watching for look like?
If I only had ten minutes today, what should I do?

situation.title: What deserves attention now
situation.prompt: The first card points to what deserves your attention now.

hidden.title: A small move to begin
hidden.prompt: The second card shows a small step you can begin.

guidance.title: What to watch for next
guidance.prompt: The last card names a signal to watch for as you move ahead.

en.title: Weekly review
en.description: Look back at the week, name what you learned, and make room for next week.
en.instruction: Help the visitor reflect on the week rather than predict the future: name its theme, identify a lesson, and suggest an intention to carry into next week.
en.example: Looking back on this week: what happened, what did I learn, and what do I want to carry into next week?

guidance.response: Back to their question, within the span of this one week: what happened, what drained them, what gave them strength, and what they are taking from it. If the question is not about this week, treat it as part of the week’s background rather than turning to predict the future.
guidance.actions: Two or three concrete things to carry into next week, each on its own line starting with "- ": one thing to keep doing, one to let go of or adjust, and one small intention to put in next week’s calendar. No grand goals.
guidance.reflection: One question that looks back over the week, a single sentence, pointing at what has already happened rather than predicting.
guidance.followUp: Stay within this one week: help them look back at what has happened and what it left them with, without predicting or planning next week at length.

quickFollowUps: Which moment of this week is worth remembering?
Which card is most like me this week?
What can I set down next week?

situation.title: The theme of the week
situation.prompt: The first card looks back at the week’s clearest theme.

hidden.title: What you are taking from it
hidden.prompt: The second card reveals what this week has taught you.

guidance.title: An intention for next week
guidance.prompt: The last card offers an intention to carry into next week.
